new_value: {"description":"Implement COSE_Sign1 codec for GCP-7.1 handoff messages in Rust lichen-gateway. Existing handoff.rs has protocol logic (NodeRegistry, handle_handoff_request, accept_handoff, finalize_handoff) and trust.rs has sign/verify_gateway_message — but no COSE_Sign1 envelope encoding/decoding. Add: (1) HandoffRequestCoseSign1 struct with from_cose_sign1/to_cose_sign1 methods matching Python handoff.py:919-984; (2) protected header {1:-65537}, unprotected {4:kid=gateway_iid}; (3) RFC 9052 Sig_structure computation → SHA256 → Schnorr48 sign/verify via existing trust.rs functions; (4) HandoffRequestCosePayload with integer keys 1-6 (node, old_gw, seq, ts, expiry, rssi); (5) HandoffConfirmCosePayload with integer keys 1-6 (node, new_gw, seq, ts, link_epoch, link_seq); (6) alg -65537 check on decode (reject others). Test against gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.json vectors (comprehensive: valid, replay, expired, wrong-alg, wrong-kid)."}
